description: Moore-Miller Campaign Continues Multi-Seven-Figure Ad Buy With New TV Ads And Focus On Black Media The Moore-Miller for Maryland campaign has launched a statewide multi-seven-figure ad buy that includes two new tv ads focused on the real results he’s delivered for Maryland and direct outreach to the Black community through targeted digital, radio, and print […]
title: Gov. Wes Moore Launches Statewide Ad Blitz Highlighting Real Results In Maryland - Wes Moore for Maryland
